text: dsh-bundles 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的网页插件合集管理器。它在设置页提供按工作角色浏览的合集卡片，可预览每套方案包含的社区插件，并查看插件介绍、安装来源和市场信息。用户可以一键安装整套插件、查看实时进度，也能安全卸载或将既有完整安装纳入管理；终端还支持安装、卸载、列表和状态查询。适合希望按开发、创作等场景快速配置 DSH 的用户。需要 DSH profile 和可用的 pnpm/npm 网络环境；远程目录不可用时会使用内置合集。

dsh-bundles adds persona-based plugin bundles to DSH settings and the CLI. Users can preview plugins, inspect details, install or remove bundles, and track ownership. Pre-existing and shared plugins are preserved. A DSH profile and network access are needed; a built-in catalog is the fallback.

dsh-bundles 的「合集浏览」功能：在 DSH 设置页展示按人群组织的插件方案。用户可展开合集查看插件列表，并打开单个插件详情查看安装来源、仓库及可用的市场信息。
dsh-bundles 的「一键安装」功能：按选中的合集顺序逐个安装其中的插件，并在页面显示进度和每项结果；已安装项目会跳过，必装项失败时可恢复 profile 快照。
dsh-bundles 的「合集卸载」功能：根据所有权台账规划移除项；卸载合集时保留预先安装或仍被其他合集引用的插件。
dsh-bundles 的「命令行管理」功能：通过 install、adopt、uninstall、list 和 status 子命令操作合集，并可用 --profile 指定目标 profile。
dsh-bundles 会请求远程合集目录及插件精选注册表；远程请求失败时回退到内置目录。可通过配置关闭远程目录。
安装和卸载会修改所选 profile 的依赖清单、锁文件及插件层配置；工具会先保存清单快照以便失败时恢复。

dshbundles README · dsh-bundles：<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**One-click, persona-based plugin bundles for DeepSeek Harness.** Choose how you work, review the included community plugins, and install the complete toolkit from one card.

[Website](https://dshbundles.com) · [Plugin market](https://dshmarket.com/) · [Bundle catalog](data/bundles.json)

dshbundles README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dshbundles
```

Restart `dsh web`, then open **Settings → Plugin Bundles**.

Install a specific official or verified community bundle directly from a terminal:

```sh
npx -y dshbundles@latest install developer --profile web
```

Safely uninstall the same bundle:

```bash
npx -y dshbundles@latest uninstall developer --profile web
```

dshbundles README · Install：Successful installs write an ownership ledger to `.dsh-bundles/state.json` in the target profile. Uninstall removes only packages installed exclusively by that bundle; pre-existing packages and packages still referenced by another bundle are preserved. Use `list` and `status [bundle-id]` to inspect installation and management state. Legacy adoption requires explicit confirmation and claims packages without another ownership record; it never happens automatically, so independently installed packages are not silently made removable.
dshbundles README · Install：For source testing before a release, use `dsh plugin --profile web add --allow-build=dshbundles github:LM20230311/dsh-bundles#main`.

dshbundles README · Use a bundle：1. Click anywhere on a persona card to expand its plugin list.
2. Click a plugin row to inspect its description, source, repository, and market metadata.
3. Click **Install all** to install the complete bundle and watch live progress; afterwards, use **Safe uninstall** from the same card. For a complete legacy install, use **Manage legacy install** first.

dshbundles README · Use a bundle：Already-installed plugins are skipped. Before changing the profile, dsh-bundles snapshots `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`; if a required plugin fails, it restores the previous dependency state.

Each pnpm command has a three-minute default deadline. A timeout terminates the complete process group and enters the existing rollback path instead of leaving the UI stuck on “installing”. Set `DSHBUNDLES_PNPM_TIMEOUT_MS` to override the deadline in milliseconds on slower networks.

dshbundles README · What you get：| Capability | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Persona bundles | 6 curated toolkits and 29 community plugins for developers, creators, designers, students, researchers, and fun |
| One-click workflow | Full-card expansion, bundle preview, one-click install, safe uninstall, live progress, and per-plugin results |
| Plugin details | Install source and repository links for every catalog entry; richer descriptions, author, downloads, stars, categories, and screenshots when dshmarket is installed |
| Safe recovery | Skips installed packages, preserves pre-existing/shared plugins, and rolls back failed install or uninstall operations |
| Shared catalog | Verified community bundles come from dshbundles.com; [`data/bundles.json`](data/bundles.json) remains the offline fallback |

dshbundles README · dshmarket integration：[dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) is optional. Install it directly from the bundle page, then use localized dshmarket detail links to inspect, update, or remove individual plugins. Remote community bundles are accepted only when every npm package is present in dshmarket's curated registry.

dshbundles README · Submit a bundle：Publish a community bundle at [dshbundles.com/publish](https://dshbundles.com/publish). The site validates every package against dshmarket's curated registry and exposes verified bundles to the same catalog consumed inside DSH.

To propose or update an official built-in bundle:

dshbundles README · Submit a bundle：1. Edit [`data/bundles.json`](data/bundles.json).
2. Give every bundle a unique `id`, localized `persona` and `tagline`, and at least one plugin.
3. Use `target` for GitHub or tarball installation sources when the plugin name is not directly installable.
4. Run `npm run check`, then open a pull request.

dshbundles README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run check
npm run audit:bundles
```

`npm run check` runs both TypeScript projects, the installer/route tests, and the client bundle build. `npm run audit:bundles` checks npm availability, DSH manifests, release activity, and weekly download signals for every official plugin, then updates [`reports/bundle-audit.md`](reports/bundle-audit.md).
